items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Lee Wiley was working for him, and he eventually sold it to her when he moved to New York to set up shop in New York.

ctx.x: Is that where Lee Wiley later (?)?

Right. See, that's the same place. Lee Wiley was working for him, and he eventually sold it to her when he moved to New York to set up shop in New York. Now, that's where he was when we recorded for him. Howard McGhee... We made his second outing. And that's where I made what I later on found out to be a classic recording, "Up In Dodo's Room," with Howard McGhee's band. Dodo Marmarosa, the great pianist, was playing piano.
